verdict.rationale: Lineage is a fair question for a data-integration platform like Airbyte, but the evidence pack documents no lineage view or lineage metadata showing which sources, steps, and transformations produced each table. The Connection Timeline (historical connection events and logs) and the one-to-one stream-to-table mapping are related features, not end-to-end lineage, and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I see end-to-end lineage of my datasets — which sources, steps, and transformations produced each table
